description: Morning GO/MODIFY/REST decision from HRV, resting HR, sleep hours and load; pass `rules` to use your own thresholds. Each signal has its value, reference, rating (ok, yellow, red; unknown when data is missing) and a readable detail; plus rules_used and a recommendation. Garmin's own scores (Training Readiness, Body Battery, stress; sleep score in the sleep value) are shown as info, not counted. REST needs a red pair (hrv with rhr or sleep, load with hrv, rhr or sleep), a single red or 2 yellow give MODIFY; decision_rule "count" instead gives REST at decision_red_min reds. Use for "how am I today" or "can I do a hard session". Example: {"date":"2026-10-12"}.

rules.description: Own thresholds, any of (default): hrv_red_base_factor 0.9, hrv_red_mean28_factor 0.85, hrv_yellow_weekly_factor 0.9, rhr_red_delta 5, rhr_yellow_delta 3, sleep_h_red 6, sleep_h_yellow 7, acwr_red 1.5, acwr_yellow 1.3, tsb_red -30, tsb_yellow -20, decision_rule pairs, decision_red_min 1, decision_yellow_min 2

name: get_readiness
title: Morning readiness
